summary: transform changes how an element is drawn: rotate() turns it, translate() moves it, and scale() resizes it. The rest of the layout acts as if the element had not moved.
notes: rotate(-4deg) tilts the first note 4 degrees counterclockwise.
translate(0, 16px) moves the second note down 16px, but the board still saves space for it in its original spot.
A new transform replaces the old one. To keep both, list them together: transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1.1);
pitfall: Writing two transform declarations in one rule, like transform: rotate(5deg); transform: scale(2);. The second replaces the first, so the element only scales.
